home.tagline: Professional creative tools powered by local AI

products.allProductsDesc: Professional creative tools powered by local AI. No subscriptions, no cloud lock-in, no compromises.
products.readyToCreateDesc: Download the XENO Hub to get started with the entire suite.

pixel.name: XENO Pixel
pixel.desc: Professional image editing with AI-powered tools. Layers, brushes, masks, filters, generation, and vector — all running locally.
pixel.shortDesc: Professional image editor. Layers, brushes, masks, filters, AI generation, and vector tools.
pixel.ctaDesc: Free, open source, and running entirely on your machine.

motion.name: XENO Motion
motion.desc: Professional video editing and compositing. Timeline, effects, color grading, motion graphics, and AI-powered editing — all running locally.
motion.shortDesc: Video editor and compositor. Timeline, effects, color grading, motion graphics, and AI editing.
motion.ctaDesc: Free, open source, and running entirely on your machine.

sound.name: XENO Sound
sound.desc: Professional DAW with multi-track recording, mixing, mastering, effects, and AI audio tools — all running locally.
sound.shortDesc: Digital audio workstation. Multi-track recording, mixing, mastering, effects, and AI audio tools.
sound.ctaDesc: Free, open source, and running entirely on your machine.

hub.name: XENO Hub
hub.desc: Your desktop command center. Launch apps, chat with AI agents, manage models, track credits, and configure the entire XENO ecosystem.
hub.shortDesc: Desktop launcher and AI workspace. Manage apps, agents, models, credits, and settings.
hub.ctaDesc: The Hub is your gateway to the entire creative suite.

agentCli.name: XENO Agent CLI
agentCli.desc: Autonomous terminal AI agent for coding, file management, and system operations from your shell.
agentCli.shortDesc: Terminal AI agent. Autonomous coding, file management, and system operations from your shell.

3d.name: XENO 3D
3d.desc: AI-native 3D suite with polygon modeling, sculpting, UV mapping, PBR materials, animation, path tracing, and procedural generation.
3d.shortDesc: 3D modeling, animation, and rendering. Sculpting, UV mapping, PBR materials, path tracing, and procedural generation.

architect.name: XENO Architect
architect.desc: AI-native architecture and CAD tool with BIM, parametric design, 2D drafting, 3D viewport, AI floor plans, and IFC support.
architect.shortDesc: Architecture and CAD. BIM modeling, parametric design, 2D drafting, AI floor plans, and IFC support.

engine.name: XENO Engine
engine.desc: AI-native game engine with ECS architecture, real-time PBR rendering, physics, scripting, multiplayer, and cross-platform export.
engine.shortDesc: Game engine. ECS architecture, real-time PBR rendering, physics, scripting, multiplayer, and cross-platform export.

workflow.name: XENO Workflow
workflow.desc: AI-native visual workflow automation. Build pipelines connecting all XENO apps and external services with a node-based editor.
workflow.shortDesc: Visual workflow automation. AI-native pipelines connecting all XENO apps and external services.

lib.name: XENO Lib
lib.desc: 17 AI models for image generation, upscaling, segmentation, depth estimation, and more. Built in Rust with ONNX and CUDA.
lib.shortDesc: AI model library. 17 models for image generation, upscaling, segmentation, depth, and more.
